scope: 六英雄封印至七式主武器基础装备定义，含来源已列真分支；不是全装备目录或完整成长系统。

identity_policy.branches_excluded: 白龙刀、黑灵剑及青雨丸等独立分支不作为主武器换皮生成。
identity_policy.faction_policy: 项目主武器普通/真均允许正邪，一阶另允许unselected以衔接一转未选派；不复制派别成两件同名定义，具体动作/武功派别按能力合同校验。

hero_mainline_weapon.unique_lineage: each character owns exactly the initial exclusive main-weapon lineage across bags/warehouse/equipment; recipes consume source and replace lineage output atomically
hero_mainline_weapon.property_contributors: stats are source base weapon range only; enhancement/synthesis/awakening/element/jade/four-divine contributions belong to independently typed growth definitions, never included a second time in stats
hero_mainline_weapon.source_limits: 15 is project permanent-enhancement design limit for these new base definitions; does not settle 15+[n] display boosts, recipes or probability tables
hero_mainline_weapon.permissions_evidence: 血雨丸禁出售/丢弃/交易/分解保官方公开；其余五英雄采用同保护权限是项目选择，非声称官网一致。
hero_mainline_weapon.permissions_scope: named class progression/true conversion/hero-transfer may consume exact source despite generic decomposition disabled; ordinary materials and other weapon families cannot inherit that exception

equip_policy.alive_and_normal_equipment_service_rules: 装备行为沿13/17合同，非商店服务；必须合法等级/rank/职业/路线并校验唯一归属。
equip_policy.level_and_rank_independent: 火龙刀与血雨丸六转目录装备门槛110、minimum_rank6；六转角色任务最低115，因此正常流程115后才可能装备。不得把目录110改写成官网115或降低角色门槛。
equip_policy.true_flag: instance true_equipment must equal explicit definition.true_equipment, not name matching; merit_equipment false for this family
equip_policy.weight_policy: all stages including true share that class sealed weight, explicitly project stable weight, not official table data
equip_policy.base_attack_policy: add weapon_attack_min/max once into existing accepted-action attack snapshot; do not roll this range independently again
equip_policy.zero_growth_semantics: a formally defined fresh upgraded instance at enhancement0 has base range; transfer outputs must validate every inherited growth field against its named growth contract before activation

exclusive_initial_lineage_recipe_only.recipe_validation: only explicitly adopted recipe with exact item output; family label alone never grants availability. New definition is not a free replacement or shop entry.
exclusive_initial_lineage_recipe_only.other_recipe_status: 95 advancement and29 true conversion recipes explicitly adopted; every nonzero inherited growth field still requires its owning schema.
exclusive_initial_lineage_recipe_only.progression_owner_file: 英雄主武器晋阶与提真.v1.json

named_growth_contracts_required.unlisted_processing: configuration cannot advertise a generic smith option merely because enhancement_limit15; recipe/type/probability/material/fee must be explicitly adopted
named_growth_contracts_required.registered_fields: instance schema and every nonzero source contribution must have an owning growth definition. Unknown field or unsupported inherited state is configuration error, never silently deleted.
named_growth_contracts_required.initial_seals: 六封印初始实例仍+0；强化上限15与具名英雄强化合同现已采用，首次+1需主动买石并付费，不自动发物。
remaining: 强化逐级属性/概率/费用/材料来源与失败保护已由英雄主武器强化.v1.json采用，运行与经济校准待P/T。
英雄合成/神物之石、火/毒武器属性石、觉醒/四神、奇玉与进化已采用；当前三名NPC武者投影已采用，其他属性/普通武器/防具成长仍待。
同阶段提真的29配方/材料/数量/费用/降2已由英雄主武器晋阶与提真.v1.json采用；完整目标成长兼容仍待。
英雄武器天池神丹附加提升由英雄武器附加提升.v1.json采用；其他道具/防具与属性显示提升仍待。
12件170级七式主武器与95件低阶段的反气功预算已由英雄武器反气功预算.v1.json明确；其他装备/首饰/道具完整预算仍待。

synthesis_owner_ref.file: 英雄武器合成与神物之石.v1.json

implementation_gate: Formal base metadata is present; runtime activation still requires complete named growth schemas/recipes and acquisition paths. Never treat source rows or empty growth modes as a fully implemented weapon system.

instance_growth_schema.applies_to: all107 exact formal hero definitions including6 initial seals; validates logical set of flat instance growth fields, does not introduce a nested growth container or relocate existing fields; identity/ownership/provenance remains under05/17

owner_ref.file: 英雄武器合成与神物之石.v1.json

instance_growth_schema.strict_types: integer never accepts booleans/floats/numeric strings; boolean never accepts0/1. Arrays/objects must match named owner; null distinct from missing. No default insertion/coercion on new-format load or processing.
cross_field_rules: exact instance stage/true/merit match definition, including initial sealed stage0
positive awakening/evolution requires stage>=5; nonnull four_divine requires awakening>=1

nonnull boost requires exact24 eligible definition and real enhancement15; target ownership/equip eligibility on use checked separately, temporary legal qualification loss does not corrupt saved boost
all nested property/value/ranges and receipt ancestry must pass owning contract; valid top-level types do not prove complete legal state
instance_growth_schema.known_identity_fields: ownership/instance ID/lineage/lock/receipts are validated by existing05/17 and named transforms, not blindly copied as growth fields
instance_growth_schema.unknown_field_policy: unregistered growth field on a flat instance is an error under full05/17 instance schema; recognized root identity fields are not rejected for being outside this growth registry. No broad unknown-root allowance, deletion or default repair.
instance_growth_schema.processing: all named hero weapon services validate this same registry and own operation before quote/commit; guard active boost before any mutation. Craft without a weapon target does not invent/validate a phantom weapon.
instance_growth_schema.transforms: validate source and fully projected target before input consumption/output ID commit; preserve or explicitly transform every registered field per named recipe, recompute all derived contributions from target inputs once, no stale source cache
